title: Per-route rollout lineage & regression-correlation workspace
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem statement: When a canary or A/B variant shows performance or quality regressions, engineers need a single, route-aware workspace that ties together per-route metrics, request traces, and traffic-slice lineage to surface likely causes and recommend rollback actions. Current Console views are fragmented: metrics, traces, and traffic routing are separate, which slows diagnosis and increases blast radius when teams revert manually.

Objective: Deliver a Console-first "Rollout Lineage & Regression Workspace" that: (1) shows a per-route timeline of metric deltas across rollout phases (canary, A/B, shadow), (2) links regression windows to representative traces and trace clusters, (3) highlights routing changes and variant exposures by customer cohort, and (4) provides an auto-rollback recommendation panel with configurable thresholds and playbook links.

Scope: UI components (timeline, metric diff table, trace-linking pane, rollback recommender); backend telemetry aggregator (per-route rollup, cohort tagging, snapshot diffs); alerting rule templates and default thresholds; lightweight experiment for shadow-replay correlation. Excludes: full automated rollback implementation (we will surface recommendations and one-click pre-approved rollback flows in a follow-up), long-term storage changes beyond 90 days telemetry retention for rollout snapshots.
acceptance_criteria: Workspace appears under Route > Rollouts for deployments with > 100 requests/minute during the rollout window
Timeline shows per-route metric trajectories (latency P95, error-rate, hallucination proxy score) for baseline and variant lanes with configurable window size
Clicking a metric delta opens a panel with the top 3 representative traces and a link to the full trace explorer
Trace samples are annotated with rollout metadata (variant id, route, timestamp, customer cohort) and stored with the rollout snapshot
A diff table lists top 10 statistically significant prompt/output regressions between baseline and variant with sample prompts and scoring metrics
Rollback recommender surfaces a suggested action (rollback, throttle, increase baseline traffic) with explanation and associated confidence score
API endpoints exist for fetching rollout snapshots, cohort metrics, and trace links: GET /rollouts/{id}/snapshot, GET /rollouts/{id}/traces, GET /rollouts/{id}/cohorts
Telemetry and UI respond within the SLO: workspace load < 4s for rollouts with up to 1M tokens in the snapshot window
success_metrics: Mean time to detect regression (MTTD) for rollouts reduced from 38m to < 15m in pilot customers
Mean time to diagnose root cause reduced from 2.1h to < 45m for monitored routes
Percentage of rollback recommendations accepted by engineers during pilot >= 70%
False positive rate for automatic regression alerts < 8% with default thresholds
technical_notes: Use existing telemetry ingestion (trace picker) to mark rollout-bound traces with rollout_id and variant tags at the proxy layer
Compute snapshot diffs using windowed bootstrap + Bayesian effect size to prioritize significant regressions instead of simple t-tests
Store rollout snapshots in the 'rollout-snapshots' timeseries index with a 90-day TTL; snapshot contains aggregated metrics and pointers to representative traces (trace_id list)
For shadow traffic, keep traffic tagging consistent between primary and shadow lanes to enable request-level correlation for replay comparisons
Security: ensure that sample prompts and outputs in the UI are redacted per PII policy before surfacing to the workspace
Performance: precompute delta scores for common time windows (5m, 15m, 1h) to meet the 4s UI load SLO
implementation_plan: Week 1: Design spike and API contract (frontend, snapshot payload, cohort filters) — PM + Design + Eng
Week 2: Telemetry tagging and snapshot writer (ENG-231110) — infra + runtime
Week 3: Backend aggregator and diff engine (ENG-231112) — build per-route rollup jobs
Week 4: Frontend timeline and metric diff table (DES-231980) — incremental UI with feature flag
Week 5: Trace linking and representative trace selector (ENG-231133) — integrate with trace store
Week 6: Rollout recommender rules + alert templates — product rules + SRE validation
Week 7: Internal pilot with 3 teams (Search, Assistant, Content-moderation) — collect feedback
Week 8: Iterate and ship beta behind permissioned flag; prepare docs and runbook
